samples.author: Brandon
samples.text: Crazy good dinner at Le Supreme! Everything about this place was great. Food was amazing. Most of our group had the FILET MIGNON EN CROUTE. Basically it was there take on beef wellington.This is a friday special. I was blow away on how this meal tasted! The mash potatoes were perfect creamy...the glazed carrots were delicious! Drinks were great service was perfect. Atmosphere was relaxing.

samples.author: Alyse Gray
samples.text:
We chose Le Suprême for our anniversary celebration and it was a great experience!

When we arrived, our table wasn't quite ready, but the staff was attentive and recommended we grab a drink at the beautiful bar, which was a nice start to the evening.

The Food
For our appetizer, we split the Salade Lyonnaise, which was perfectly executed—a great, traditional French starter.

For the entrees:

Lapin à la Moutarde: I was encouraged to try the rabbit (a first for me!) and it was quite flavorful. The meat was surprisingly sweet and tender. My only small note is that I wished the accompanying tagliatelle had been served with a bit more sauce to fully coat the pasta.

Burger du Maison: My husband went with the house burger and was very satisfied. The burger was cooked well and the fries had a nice bite and were perfectly seasoned.

We ended the meal flawlessly with the profiteroles served with warm dark chocolate sauce. It was the perfect classic French dessert to finish our celebration.

L

samples.author: Meg Von Everec
samples.text:
We were in town for a concert and stopped in for brunch before leaving Detroit, and we weren’t disappointed!!

Our server started our meal by telling us about the history of the restaurant and the building, which was fun to learn about! We started with some lovely pastries - the pain au chocolat was probably the best I’ve ever had!

I got Eggs Benedict and my husband got the Quiche Lorraine. Both were delicious! The quiche was flavourful, had the perfect flaky crust and just melted in your mouth. My eggs were poached perfectly, and the hollandaise sauce had just a touch of sweetness - exactly how I like it. The potatoes were crisp on the outside and light and fluffy inside, and seasoned well.

The portion sizes here are so generous! I was very impressed. It’s definitely great food and well worth the price. We really enjoyed our time here and will definitely be stopping back for dinner service next time we’re in Detroit!

samples.author: Preston Abadie
samples.text: The food was amazing. The Wild Mushroom Tort was delicious. The Stoned Love cocktail was truly smooth and silky. The Coquille Grenoblois was superb, and the filet mignon was flavorful, moist, and had a peppery crust that tied it all together. The service was impeccable, and the atmosphere was cool, calm, and casually elegant without anything pretentious. This is a must go restaurant.

samples.author: Patryk Paletko-Ali
samples.text:
Great spot for date night or just night out on town. There is some outdoor seating as well, but the inside has a very fun, vibrant atmosphere.  It is a bit loud, as tables are close together,  and there is overhead music playing, but you can still have a conversation without shouting at each other.
The service is fairly fast and really good. All the staff members we encountered were very pleasant and accommodating.
The food was really good. Maybe not outstanding but definitely a solid choice. So were the signature cocktails we tried.
I strongly recommend it and definitely will be back. Also, prices are actually reasonable for a this type of restaurant.
